question: In a clinical study to evaluate the efficacy of a new medication in the treatment of migraine crisis (point out the CORRECT):

options.opa: Strict inclusion criteria increase the external validity of the study.
options.opb: Strict exclusion criteria reduce the internal validity of the study.
options.opc: Control with a placebo arm increases the external validity of the study.
options.opd: Masking reduces the internal validity of the study.
options.ope: Randomization increases the internal validity of the study.

analysis: In a clinical study evaluating the efficacy of a new medication in the treatment of migraine crisis, randomization is a key method to reduce bias and increase the internal validity of the study. Strict inclusion criteria may limit generalizability but can enhance internal validity by ensuring a more homogeneous study population. Exclusion criteria are important to reduce confounding variables and improve internal validity. Placebo control arms are essential for comparing the new medication to standard treatment or placebo, enhancing internal validity. Masking, or blinding, is crucial to reduce bias and improve internal validity.
